subject: PrivNet control-plane telemetry gap — evidence bundle and customer action plan
thread_body:
From: Samir Patel <samir@railcarhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Jules Tan <jules.tan@railcarhealth.com>, support@railcarhealth.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: [RAILCAR] Observed control-plane gap — instances losing management connection intermittently

Vivek / Redwood team,

We started seeing sporadic management-plane disconnects against our Private VPC (privnet-railcar-prod) around 08:50 PDT. The agents report re-attaching but there is a 2–3 minute window where the control-plane telemetry stops and requests queue on our side. This has caused a handful of customer-facing model requests to timeout.

Can you confirm whether there was any rollout or control-plane maintenance in our region? We haven't scheduled anything on our side. I'm attaching a small pcap and the agent logs we captured.

Thanks,
Samir
Operations Lead — Railcar Health

--- Attachment: packet-dump-20260630.pcap (redacted) ---

----------
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@railcarhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:45:13 -0700
Subject: Re: [RAILCAR] Observed control-plane gap — instances losing management connection intermittently

Hi Samir — thanks for the data and flag. We're looking into this now. Quick summary of next steps from our side: 
- We will collect the agent diagnostics and control-plane traces for the 08:30–09:30 window.
- Jordan will review the orchestrator rollout history for your region and confirm any orchestrator or config changes.
- We'll produce an evidence bundle and a short mitigation runbook within the next 8 hours.

I'm looping in Mina (SRE lead) for telemetry and runbook. Apologies for the impact — we'll escalate as needed.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

----------
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>; Samir Patel <samir@railcarhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:18:07 -07:00
Subject: Re: [RAILCAR] Observed control-plane gap — instances losing management connection intermittently

Samir — performed an initial pass on the logs you attached. Two quick findings: 
1) There is a burst of control-plane RPC latency between 08:46:12 and 08:48:55 where the median control RPC p99 crosses 1.6s; several keepalive timeouts coincide with that window.
2) No orchestrator rollout was scheduled at the time — Jordan confirmed a non-prod config push earlier but none targeted your privnet.

I'm attaching a compacted telemetry excerpt (controlplane-telemetry-compact-20260630.json) and a short mitigation runbook. Jordan / I will continue with deeper trace pulls and a packet-level comparison.

Mina Haddad
SRE, Redwood Inference

--- Attachments: controlplane-telemetry-compact-20260630.json, privnet-reconnect-runbook-v1.pdf ---

----------
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>; Samir Patel <samir@railcarhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:02:41 -07:00
Subject: Re: [RAILCAR] Observed control-plane gap — instances losing management connection intermittently

Update from the orchestrator side: there was an automated leader rebalancing event in a neighboring AZ at 08:45 which increased cross-AZ control traffic. It didn't target your control-plane cluster but we see correlated upticks in latency for any clusters with heavy prefix caching activity. We're checking for kernel-level TCP retransmit spikes that could explain the 2–3 minute noise window.

I'll attach the timeline and a filtered pcap snippet.

Jordan Blake
Platform Reliability Engineer

--- Attachment: support-evidence-bundle-railcar-20260630.zip (contains traces/logs/index) ---

----------
From: Samir Patel <samir@railcarhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:10:55 -07:00
Subject: Re: [RAILCAR] Observed control-plane gap — instances losing management connection intermittently

Thanks — appreciate the quick triage. Two asks from our side: 
1) We need an interim mitigator/runbook we can execute if this recurs during our peak traffic (09:00–11:00 PDT).
2) We'd like the packet-level pcap redacted to show only the session metadata (no payload) and a short timeline we can share with our internal security/compliance team.

If you can provide both by EOD that would help our on-call rotation.

— Samir

----------
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@railcarhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [RAILCAR] Observed control-plane gap — evidence bundle and customer action plan

Samir — attaching the redacted pcap, a compact telemetry excerpt, and a one-page runbook your SREs can use for an immediate mitigation. Summary of what we found and recommended next steps: 

Summary: 
- Root cause: transient control-plane RPC latency spike correlated with a neighboring AZ leader rebalance; amplified by synchronous keepalive behavior in older agent versions.
- Impact window: 08:46:12–08:49:05 PDT on 2026-06-30. Impacted 6 agents in your privnet cluster; up to 2–3 minute queued requests were observed and 0.4% increased request failures during the window.

Remediations provided: 
- Short-term runbook (attached privnet-reconnect-runbook-v1.pdf): steps to temporarily increase agent keepalive threshold and trigger graceful reconnect. Recommended if you see >1% failures in a 15-minute window.
- Evidence bundle (support-evidence-bundle-railcar-20260630.zip): includes filtered traces and the controlplane-telemetry excerpt. The pcap is redacted to session headers only (packet-dump-20260630.pcap).
- Mid-term: we will schedule a control-plane tuning patch that reduces synchronous keepalive pressure for older agents; we'll share the scheduling window by July 9.

Requested items / asks for you: 
1) Please confirm receipt and whether the runbook is actionable in your environment.
2) If your security team needs a dedicated export (FIRMS format), tell us and we will produce it within 48 hours.

Attachments in this message: privnet-reconnect-runbook-v1.pdf, controlplane-telemetry-compact-20260630.json, packet-dump-20260630.pcap (redacted), support-evidence-bundle-railcar-20260630.zip

Thanks again for the fast signal — we will follow up with a brief post-incident write-up when the mid-term patch is scheduled.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

---
From: Samir Patel <samir@railcarhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [RAILCAR] Observed control-plane gap — evidence bundle and customer action plan

Received and validated the runbook. We'll test the keepalive threshold change in our staging cluster this afternoon and feed back any notes. Please add the mid-term tuning patch to the July 9 window and share the release notes. Appreciate the thoroughness and quick turn.

-Samir
Operations Lead — Railcar Health
